goal: Stop ignoring wallet database write and erase failures across the wallet subsystem
Prevent in-memory state from silently desynchronizing from disk records to avoid corruption or data loss
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Ensures consistency between in-memory and database behavior (rkrux)
Concerns about rollbacks and error reporting resolved by treating write failures as catastrophic (jeanpablojp)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because silent database write failures risk wallet desynchronization, corruption, and data loss
Protects fund safety by ensuring failed disk operations abort rather than leaving records out of sync
